description: This file defines a class PregReplaceCallbackClosureTypeExtension that implements logic related to PHPStan static method type extension, specifically for handling regex replacement callbacks with detailed type inference based on regex pattern matching. It is part of the Composer Pcre library, helping static analysis tools to understand the types during preg_replace callback operations.

classes.name: PregReplaceCallbackClosureTypeExtension
classes.description: Implements PHPStan's static method parameter closure type extension for preg_replace callback methods, inferring the return type based on regex pattern analysis and handling strict group matches.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the regex shape matcher.

methods.name: isStaticMethodSupported
methods.description: Checks if the current static method and parameter are supported by this extension.

methods.name: getTypeFromStaticMethodCall
methods.description: Infers the return type of preg_replace callback methods based on the regex pattern and flags passed.
